Add a contact in Twenty

1Open People

Every person your team talks to lives in People. Click it in the sidebar to see your contacts, their companies, and their phone numbers at a glance.

2Create the contact

To add someone new, click Create. Twenty opens a blank record for them straight away.

3Open the full record

Click Expand to work on a full page instead of the side panel. You get more room for the details.

4Name the contact

Click Untitled, then type the first name, Rina, and the last name, Castellano. When both are in, press Enter to save.

5Add the email

Now her email. Click Emails and type the address. You can add as many as you need. Then press Enter to save it.

6Add the job title

Next, click Job Title and type her role, Office Coordinator. Then press Enter.

7Link her company

To link her company, click the pencil beside Company, search for Sundial, and pick Sundial Solar. Her record now belongs to that account.

8Check the timeline

Everything you changed is logged in the timeline, so your whole team can see who updated what, and when. That's one new contact, ready to work with.
